title: Wrong Design Intent Is Worse Than Never Conditioning: A Derangement-Control Diagnosis of Header Conditioning in CAD Program Completion
abstract: Fine-tuned code LLMs are routinely conditioned on a design-intent specification, but the correctness axis of such a signal -- a wrong intent rather than an absent one -- has not been tested, and the benefit of conditioning is usually scored with the same detector that defines the signal. We study CADCON, a five-feature design-intent header prepended to CadQuery-style programs during LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B, scoring adherence with executable geometric assertions that share no code with the header-defining extractor. On a pre-registered sample of 400 deduplicated held-out programs stratified over eleven intent profiles, at 40% prefix and three seeds, a semantically wrong header degrades adherence below the never-header-trained baseline on 3/3 seeds under both tokenizations at the program level, and on 3/3 token and 2/3 text seeds at the 298 distinct model inputs they present. Wrong-header executability is not depressed relative to that baseline. A derangement control, retrained so every program receives another program's header -- holding the header marginal fixed while destroying its correlation with the program -- saw the same programs, indices and wrong headers. Its correct-to-wrong change is -0.006/+0.016/-0.003 against 0.124/0.241/0.230 for the standard model, and the interaction is significant on 3/3 seeds (p <= 5.9e-7), so the model's sensitivity to whether the header is right or wrong requires the learned mapping. The control sits below the baseline by the same margin under a correct as under a wrong header, so we claim that sensitivity and not the below-baseline level. On features the true intent lacks, the standard model realizes a feature far more often when the wrong header names it; the control does not. Ground truth itself scores only 0.567 here, the scale on which arm levels should be read. Wrong design intent is not inert: it actively misdirects generation.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2607.23191v4 exact-version PDF、文本抽取与页面渲染整理；PDF 共 47 页，SHA-256 3ba73542f20923d8e84a7b3d115b39a6db426d132310f6109dcff1b7707580f1，视觉核验第 1、2、8、9 页。本次 exact-version review 未确认可发布的 Code link。
analysis.ideaZh: CADCON v4 是实质更新：在 v3 的 400-program pre-registered replication 与 derangement control 上，新增 independently pre-registered extractor-repair inference run；修复 first-result truncation 后 wrong-header 仍劣于 never-conditioned，削弱了原结果由 scoring asymmetry 造成的替代解释。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它直接审计 design-conditioned CAD agent 的错误上游意图：不仅问 conditioning 是否有效，还用 causal control 区分 learned semantic mapping 与机械性的 off-distribution reaction，并用独立 B-rep assertions 避免自指式评分。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者在 400 个 deduplicated held-out programs、11 个 intent profiles、298 个 distinct 40%-prefix inputs 上报告 wrong-vs-none：program level 两种 tokenization 均 3/3 seeds 显著；distinct-input level 为 token 3/3、text 2/3。text wrong-header executability 为 0.638，对应 baseline 为 0.603；derangement-control interaction 在 3/3 seeds 显著（p≤5.9×10^-7）。v4 的 extractor-repair retest 在允许模型 continuation 越过首个 result block 的 scoring surface 上仍复现 deficit；数字均为作者报告，未独立复现。
analysis.caveatZh: 结论只覆盖 40% prefix conditional completion；0% prefix 下 baseline 不能生成有效 CAD，wrong-vs-none 无定义。400 programs 只形成 298 distinct inputs，11 个 profile 的 effect 强异质且 3 个方向相反。extractor-repair 复验复用原 checkpoints，62.7% multi-stage generations 在两种 extraction 下相同、仅 11.2% scored rows 改变；模型也仅为 Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B 与 DeepCAD/CadQuery task family。
analysis.motivationZh: structured generator 经常接受上游 plan 或 design-intent signal，但错误 signal 未必只让模型退化到 unconditioned baseline。CADCON 研究错误 header 是否主动误导 geometry，以及观察到的差异究竟来自 learned header→program mapping，还是罕见输入、共享 extractor 与 executability 等评测混杂。
analysis.methodZh: 作者给 CadQuery sketch-extrude programs 加入五类 intent header，训练 correct、never-header 与 derangement-header 的 matched LoRA models；测试时注入 byte-identical wrong headers。几何 adherence 由与 header extractor 不共享代码的 executable B-rep assertions 评分，并在 program、distinct-input、profile、executability 与 interaction 层面按冻结规则分析。v4 再预注册 extractor-repair retest，专门检验 first-result truncation asymmetry。
analysis.experimentsZh: pre-registered replication 使用 400 programs、11 profiles、三 seeds 与 text/token headers；wrong header 在 distinct-input unit 的六个 primary cells 中保留五个，derangement control 的 correct→wrong change 近零而 standard model 明显下降。作者还报告 independent metric 约把 text correct-header gain 减半，token ordering 受 executability 影响。v4 修复 generation extractor 后仍在两种 tokenization 与 cluster unit 复现 wrong<none，只有原本失败的 text seed 继续失败，因此更新强化的是 robustness boundary，不是新的模型能力。
analysis.insightZh: 最可迁移的结论是 conditioning interface 应具备“signal 可疑时退回 unconditioned behavior”的机制；评估则应同时包含独立于 conditioning extractor 的 outcome metric 与破坏 signal-content correlation 的 causal control。v4 的新增复验排除一个具体 truncation artifact，但没有扩大模型、representation 或 deployment domain 的外推范围。
